commentary.text: 90+10' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+8' 4 - 3 Goal! Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Vicente Guaita to commit before slotting the penalty into the bottom right corner.
90+8' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
90+8' The referee blows his whistle, a clear handball by Unai Nunez (Celta Vigo). The referee makes the call - penalty to Ath Bilbao!
90+5' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
90+5' Vicente Guaita (Celta Vigo) picks up a yellow card for an infringement.
90+1' Raul Garcia (Ath Bilbao) has tested the patience of referee Juan Pulido and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.

90' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Celta Vigo are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
89' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jorgen Strand Larsen departs the field of play to be replaced by Anastasios Douvikas (Celta Vigo).
86' A cross into the box from Carles Perez (Celta Vigo) is cleared.
85' Ernesto Valverde Tejedor has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao) replacing Oihan Sancet.
84' It looks like Raul Garcia (Ath Bilbao) saw red with that tackle. Juan Pulido won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
84' It is time for a substitution. Franco Cervi (Celta Vigo) is on for Jonathan Bamba.
80' We are about to witness a subsitution. Raul Garcia (Ath Bilbao) for Gorka Guruzeta.
80' Ernesto Valverde Tejedor decides to make a substitution. Inaki Williams will be replaced by Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao).
78' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Ath Bilbao comes to nothing.
73' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Celta Vigo.

72' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) places the ball on the penalty spot and sends it towards the bottom left corner. His effort isn't powerful enough, allowing Unai Simon to dive and keep the ball out with an excellent save.
72' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) is going to take the penalty!
72' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Celta Vigo!

71' Play continues despite the shouts by some Celta Vigo players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Juan Pulido interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
70' The resulting set piece from Celta Vigo is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
69' Rafael Benitez has decided to make a change. Luca de la Torre (Celta Vigo) replaces Fran Beltran.
69' Substitution. Dani Garcia (Ath Bilbao) has come on for Mikel Vesga.
66' 3 - 3 Fantastic team goal! Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo) was set free in the area by Iago Aspas and he made no mistake with a lovely finish into the bottom left corner. 3:3.
65' The goal by Celta Vigo is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
64' Wait! Referee Juan Pulido has indicated he is going to review the Celta Vigo goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
63' Goal! Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo) latches on to an accurate pass and quickly strikes a low effort inside the right post.
62' Ath Bilbao have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
60' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) watches the ball all the way and fires a first-time shot goalwards from inside the box, but the effort flies just over the bar.
59' An attempted cross from Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) is cleared.
57' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) jumps into a tackle and Juan Pulido signals a foul.
56' Unai Simon (Ath Bilbao) criticises the decision of the referee and immediately receives a yellow card.
52' 3 - 2 Goal! Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) fires the rebound low into the middle of the goal after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 3:2.
52' Ath Bilbao can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
50' Carlos Dotor (Celta Vigo) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
49' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
48' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) receives a lofted pass in the goal area and unleashes a dangerous header which sails a few inches over the bar!
46' Kevin Vazquez (Celta Vigo) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear.

46' Celta Vigo slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+6' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.

45+5' 2 - 2 What a wonderful finish! Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) latches on to an inch-perfect cross into the box and drills a low shot into the bottom left corner. There are not enough superlatives to describe that goal.
45+4' A cross from Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
45+3' Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.

45+2' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) wasted a huge opportunity! The fans already began to celebrate as he produced a low shot from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort. The ball went towards the middle of the goal, but Vicente Guaita made an astonishing save!
45+1' Ath Bilbao are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
45' 5 additional min. will be played.
43' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) is caught offside after the linesman raises his flag.
41' 1 - 2 Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo) hits a volley from just outside the box which goes inside the left post. What a shot that is!
40' Juan Pulido couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Dani Vivian (Ath Bilbao) and blew his whistle.
39' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) picked up a yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee. He has to be careful for the remainder of the match.
37' 1 - 1 Goal! Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) fires the rebound into the bottom left corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:1.
36' Ath Bilbao failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
36' Shots on target – 3:2.
34' Ath Bilbao are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.

33' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the middle of the goal. His effort, however, is blocked by Vicente Guaita, who pulls off a comfortable save!
33' A corner kick by Ath Bilbao is thwarted by the well prepared Vicente Guaita (Celta Vigo).
30' The corner is swung in but Ath Bilbao can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
25' 0 - 1 Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) takes a great first touch to control a killer pass on the edge of the box and drills a shot into the bottom left corner in trademark fashion.
24' Juan Pulido blows his whistle after Mikel Vesga (Ath Bilbao) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
23' Juan Pulido blows his whistle and it's Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
21' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
21' Ath Bilbao take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
19' What a wasted chance that is! A precise cross into the box finds Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao), whose header flies way wide of the left post.
19' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
19' Wonderful movement by Ath Bilbao. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
16' A brilliant individual effort! Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) tricks his way past challenges into the box and blazes his shot just a few inches over the top.
16' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) has a goal ruled out for offside!
15' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) drills a low shot from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort. The ball heads towards the right post, but the goalkeeper denies him with a fantastic save.

14' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the middle of the goal. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Vicente Guaita makes a comfortable save.
9' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
7' Unai Simon steps in and intercepts a long pass from Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo).
7' A long pass, executed by Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao), missed the precision to reach his teammates.
5' The ball is cleared after Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
2' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) sends a cross into the box, but Vicente Guaita comes off his line to gather the ball.
1' Ath Bilbao seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out at last! Celta Vigo will take the kick-off.
Juan Pulido will supervise the game today.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
Show lineups
Welcome to our live text commentary, ladies and gentlemen! The starting lineups will be announced very soon, so just sit back and get ready to enjoy the action.
